# Toyota

> > Toyota's official site showcasing its complete 2026 vehicle lineup with detailed specs, pricing, configurators, and hybrid/electric powertrain options.

Toyota.com features comprehensive product pages for sedans, SUVs, trucks, minivans, and specialty vehicles including hybrid, plug-in hybrid, and hydrogen fuel cell models. Each vehicle page includes trim levels, pricing (MSRP), exterior design galleries, performance specifications, and interactive configurators for customization.

## Key Topics

- 2026 Model Year
- Hybrid-Electric Technology
- Plug-in Hybrid (PHEV)
- Hydrogen Fuel Cell (Mirai)
- Trim Levels (XSE, SE, LE, XLE, Limited, Platinum)
- MSRP & Pricing
- Vehicle Configurator
- All-Wheel Drive (AWD)
- Exterior Colors (Midnight Black Metallic, Wind Chill Pearl, Nightshade)
- Fuel Efficiency
- Sports Performance (GR Series)
- Design Gallery
- Specifications & Features
- Off-Road Capability
- Towing & Cargo

## Sedans & Compact Cars

- [2026 Toyota Camry](https://www.toyota.com/camry): Mid-size sedan with hybrid technology, multiple trim levels, and advanced safety features
- [2026 Toyota Corolla](https://www.toyota.com/corolla/2026): Compact sedan with hybrid options, fuel efficiency, and safety technology
- [2026 Toyota Crown](https://www.toyota.com/crown): Luxury sedan with sophisticated design, AWD, and premium performance
- [2026 Toyota Crown Signia](https://www.toyota.com/crownsignia): Luxury SUV-sedan crossover with AWD, efficiency features, and refined design

## SUVs & Crossovers

- [2026 Toyota RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid](https://www.toyota.com/rav4pluginhybrid): Compact crossover with plug-in hybrid powertrain, electric range, and multiple trims
- [2026 Toyota Grand Highlander](https://www.toyota.com/grandhighlander): Three-row SUV with hybrid powertrain, spacious cargo, and flexible seating

## Trucks & Minivans

- [2026 Toyota Tundra](https://www.toyota.com/tundra): Full-size pickup truck with performance specs, towing capacity, and available hybrid
- [2026 Toyota Tacoma](https://www.toyota.com/tacoma): Mid-size truck with hybrid powertrain and off-road capability
- [2026 Toyota Sienna](https://www.toyota.com/sienna): Minivan with spacious cabin, flexible storage, and available AWD

## Hybrid & Alternative Fuel Vehicles

- [2026 Toyota Prius](https://www.toyota.com/prius): Iconic hybrid with striking design, exceptional fuel efficiency, and multiple powertrain options
- [2026 Toyota Prius Plug-In Hybrid](https://www.toyota.com/priuspluginhybrid): Plug-in hybrid with solar roof, electric range, and superior fuel efficiency
- [2026 Toyota Mirai](https://www.toyota.com/mirai): Hydrogen fuel cell sedan with zero emissions, extended fuel range, and advanced technology

## Performance & Sports Vehicles

- [2026 Toyota GR Supra](https://www.toyota.com/grsupra): Sports car with turbocharged engine and race-ready design
- [2026 Toyota GR Corolla](https://www.toyota.com/grcorolla/2026): Hot hatch with turbo engine, AWD, and track-inspired performance
- [2026 Toyota GR86](https://www.toyota.com/gr86): Sports coupe with track-ready handling and rear-wheel drive
- [2026 Toyota Corolla Hatchback](https://www.toyota.com/corollahatchback): Compact hatchback with agile handling, 2.0L engine, and sport-oriented features

## Shopping & Vehicle Discovery

- [Toyota Homepage](https://www.toyota.com): Main landing page showcasing new vehicles, models, pricing, and configuration tools
- [All Toyota Vehicles](https://www.toyota.com/all-vehicles): Complete vehicle catalog with filtering by price, fuel efficiency, and vehicle type
